experiment: F2b — closed-vs-open-loop generation ablation (re-run of the invalid F2)
why_f2_was_invalid: run_f2.sh passed --generator-limit 12; the break at agent/conjecture_generator/agent.py:299 stopped the hard-filter loop at 12 hard-filter accepts, which were drawn from the graffiti3-family candidates that lead the candidate list, so dynamic cells, the mutation engine, the support-function miner and the LLM co-proposer were never evaluated. Evidence: ldno_exp/closed/output/conjecture_generator/run_20261117_023840.json and run_20261117_025135.json contain ONLY sources 'graffiti3' and 'graffiti3:strat:p3_eq_0' (19 and 18 evaluated candidates); the limit=0 campaign logs contain all six source families.
only_allowed_change: generator limit set from 12 to 0 in both arms (f2b_setup.py / f2b_driver.py / run_f2b.sh). Every F2 patch is byte-identical to scripts/ldno/f2_setup.py: validator check-level logging (additive); prover DISABLED in the evolution loop (no-CE => survivor); open arm only: derive_signals()->empty, _dynamic_cells->[], generate_mutations->[]. LLM co-proposer + LLM review still run in BOTH arms (empty hint blocks in the open arm). No other code or configuration change.
seed_injection: PYTHONHASHSEED=<seed> and CE_CONSTRUCT_SEED=<seed> (both read by existing code; no code change). The LLM propose/review adds uncontrolled API stochasticity on top. Seed 41 was the smoke-test seed and is included as pre-approved by the protocol.

arms.closed: full feedback (signals, dynamic cells, mutation engine all active)
arms.open: open-loop patch: signals/dynamic-cells/mutations withheld from the generator; identical in every other respect

downstream_definition.A: same as the invalid run: full counterexample search via orchestrator._run_ce_search (witness-pool replay -> plantri-pool replay -> Eberhard-lattice walk -> plantri screen -> RL+LLM+Hopper+stochastic-constructor parallel tracks), prover disabled.
downstream_definition.B: deterministic downstream ONLY: witness-pool replay -> plantri-pool replay -> Eberhard-lattice walk -> plantri exhaustive screen; NO RL, LLM, or Hopper, NO stochastic constructor double-check. Implemented in f2b_driver._downstream_B as a verbatim replica of orchestrator._run_ce_search lines 976-1026 (the deterministic prefix), calling only existing agent functions with client=None; no agent code changed.

downstream_decision_rule: A iff 5 seeds x 2 arms are estimated to finish by 2026-11-17 21:00 America/New_York on the free cores; otherwise B. Decided from the runtime estimate only.

generation_wall_s_smoke_gen1.source: ldno_exp/f2b/seed41 smoke parallel run 12:48:04 start; closed done 12:55:16, open done 12:53:17

B.source: calibration on seed41/closed first 12 status=new specs, this box idle

A.source: invalid F2 run closed gen1 total 789s (run_f2.log) minus ~432s generation = ~357s / 4 refuted-fast conjectures = ~89s; F1-lite hopper mean 147.7s (ldno_exp/f1lite/f1lite_units) + RL/LLM/constructor in parallel => survivor >=160s; calibration shows 92% survive the deterministic stages and would reach the expensive tracks under A, so blended ~190s

cores_per_arm.A: 6-8 (plantri screen 3 + RL proc + Hopper proc + constructor pool + LLM)

runtime_estimate.optionA_estimate: arm K=2 (closed) = 2*(432 + 37*190) = 14924 s ~= 4.15 h; one A-arm needs 6-8 cores so only ONE seed (its 2 arms) fits on 16 cores at a time => 5 seeds sequential ~= 20.7 h. Even the optimistic all-refute-fast bound (89 s) gives 2*(432+37*89)=7450 s ~=2.07 h/seed => 10.3 h sequential. Both exceed the 7.9 h remaining. FAILS deadline.
runtime_estimate.optionB_estimate: arm K=2 (closed) = 2*(432 + 37*15.4) = 2004 s ~= 33 min; a B-arm needs 2-3 cores so 2 seeds (4 arms, ~10-12 cores) run concurrently on 16 cores => 5 seeds in 3 waves ~= 1.7 h; fully sequential ~= 2.8 h. Both well under 7.9 h. MEETS deadline.
runtime_estimate.conclusion: Option B chosen. Option A cannot finish 5 seeds x 2 arms by 21:00 NY without starving arms.

primary_metric: novel_hypothesis_cells_vs_frozen: the number of DISTINCT hypothesis cells among the arm's ACCEPTED conjectures (gen1 + gen2 together) that are NOT covered by the frozen registry. A cell is covered iff some frozen-registry conjecture has that same hypothesis cell. Hypothesis cell = the sorted set of non-'is_simple' atoms in the 'if (...)' clause (f2_metrics.hyp_cell).
secondary_metrics: distinct_hypothesis_cells_accepted: distinct hypothesis cells among the arm's accepted conjectures (both gens), covered or not — the paper's generator-level metric.

candidates_by_source: proposed, evaluated (= appears among accepted or rejected in the run log), and accepted, each broken down by source family {graffiti3_full, graffiti3_stratified, dynamic_cells, mutation_engine, support_miner, llm_coproposer}.

refuted_by_tier: accepted conjectures refuted downstream, broken down by tier/track {witness_pool_replay, plantri_pool_replay, lattice(Stage1), plantri screen}, plus the refuted fraction (refuted / accepted).
survivors: accepted conjectures with no deterministic CE (prover disabled => recorded as survivor_prover_disabled).
llm_review_drops: accepted-by-hard-filter candidates dropped by the advisory LLM review.
validator_checklevel_rejections: check-level validator rejections during downstream CE verification, by first-failing check index.

analysis_plan.per_seed: report primary and every secondary metric for BOTH arms, for all 5 seeds.
analysis_plan.aggregate: per-arm mean +/- sd across seeds; paired per-seed difference (closed - open); sign count (#seeds closed>open, closed=open, closed<open) — for the primary metric and for each numeric secondary metric.
analysis_plan.report_all_seeds: EVERY seed whose BOTH arms completed is reported, whatever the result. No seed is re-run, replaced, or excluded on account of its result. Seeds with an incomplete arm at the hard stop are reported as incomplete and excluded from the paired aggregate (but noted).

hard_stop_ny: 2026-11-17 21:00 America/New_York (epoch 1794967200). Unfinished runs are stopped; only seeds whose BOTH arms completed count; all completed seeds are reported.
isolation: Each of the 5 seeds x 2 arms is a FRESH full copy of the a1eab93 snapshot (frozen registry + witness pool + caches) under /home/felix_gao/ldno_exp/f2b/seed<seed>/<arm>. No output/, registry, witness pool, or campaign cache outside that tree is ever touched. The invalid F2 outputs in ldno_exp/{closed,open} are kept.
commitment: Report ALL seeds and ALL metrics, whatever they show.
